sample_unit: questions (4 PSA practice papers x 30 questions, each run in 3 trials)

links.outcome: ChatGPT accuracy on PSA data interpretation section versus other prescribing sections
links.effect: Data Interpretation scored 32/72 (44.44%) with variability across trials, versus 87.50% for Adverse Drug Reactions and 88.89% for Communicating Information; overall papers 66.33%-85.67%.
links.quote: However, it struggled in "Data Interpretation", scoring 32/72 (44.44%), showing variability across trials and indicating limitations in handling more complex clinical reasoning tasks.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline performance on a medical exam (Prescribing Safety Assessment practice papers) without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
